verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a self-hosted option that runs "all of Sentry" on your own server for free, and one long-term user reports it is rock-solid once running. The vendor also positions it as a "minimal setup" for "simple use cases" with "no guarantees or dedicated support," which falls short of a supported production deployment. Hands-on reports, including an acknowledgment from the founder, describe it as awful to self-host and say each release adds containers and memory, which makes upgrades painful. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted architecture, a documented upgrade path, production-grade support or guarantees, and independent evidence of smooth upgrades.
